subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a public portable multi-selection message-presentation contract, and which initial channels and fallback behavior must it guarantee?
rationale: This is a new public SDK and channel interaction contract rather than a repair to defined broken behavior; maintainers must choose the supported capability matrix and long-term fallback semantics before implementation.

options.title: Adopt a shared contract
options.body: Define one additive multi-selection block and structured array callback, then stage channel support behind documented capability and fallback behavior.

options.title: Retain single-select only
options.body: Keep the existing portable contract and direct batch-selection workflows to text replies or owner-specific integrations.

options.title: Scope a Slack-only workflow API
options.body: Treat Slack modal support as a separate provider-owned feature without representing it as cross-platform message-tool support.

recommendation.title: Adopt a shared contract
recommendation.body: Define one additive multi-selection block and structured array callback, then stage channel support behind documented capability and fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Existing shared presentation-contract history and the prior source-backed review make this the strongest available routing candidate.
